headline: Ohio House bill removes funding set aside for state childcare accessibility program
summary: Ohio House committee removed funding for Child Care Cred program from H.B. 647, potentially saving $4.6M in FY2026-27, while retaining other budget allocations unchanged.

headline: Getting school funding right in Kansas matters for students, schools, educators and the rest of us
summary: Kansas legislators are updating the state's K-12 special education funding formula, aiming for an evidence-based system that supports students' evolving needs and aligns with changing national policies.

headline: Despite threats, Maryland sheriffs quickly dropped 287(g) agreements with ICE
summary: "Seven of nine Maryland counties terminated their partnerships with ICE's 287(g) program after Governor Wes Moore signed SB 245 and HB 444 into law in February, banning such agreements. Two remaining counties may not actively participate due to immediate effect of the ban."
